tokens.name: sky-deep
tokens.usage: Top of the night sky (dithered toward `sky` at the horizon). Mostly hidden under fog during play.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Night sky at the horizon line.

tokens.name: sea-deep
tokens.usage: Sea at the bottom of the screen, furthest from the horizon.

tokens.name: sea
tokens.usage: Main sea colour just below the horizon; the water boats sail on.

tokens.name: sea-light
tokens.usage: Wave ripples in open water.

tokens.name: crest
tokens.usage: Wave crests near the horizon, foam around rocks and the island, storm rain.

tokens.name: fog
tokens.usage: Thin fog. Laid over sea and sky with a 4×4 ordered dither, cleared by the beam.

tokens.name: fog-thick
tokens.usage: Thick fog banks (the Storm Ship's fog). Lighter than `fog` on night palettes, darker on Foggy Dawn.

tokens.name: beam
tokens.usage: The lighthouse beam and the lit water under it. Must stay the lightest warm (or, on Deep Fjord, coolest) colour in the scene: it IS the feedback.

tokens.name: beam-core
tokens.usage: Centre of the lamp and the brightest pixels of a steady beam or flare.

tokens.name: lamp
tokens.usage: The lamp at rest (the minimum glow — never dark), boat lanterns, lit windows.

tokens.name: rock
tokens.usage: Shadow side of hidden rocks and island stones.

tokens.name: rock-light
tokens.usage: Lit side of rocks; stone lighthouse masonry.

tokens.name: land
tokens.usage: Island soil and cliff face.

tokens.name: grass
tokens.usage: Island grass top; seaweed accents.

tokens.name: tower
tokens.usage: Lighthouse tower paint, cottage walls, cabin walls on boats.

tokens.name: stripe
tokens.usage: Lighthouse stripes, roofs of cottages, the crab, bunting. The scene's one accent colour.

tokens.name: roof
tokens.usage: Lighthouse roof cap, gallery railing, doors; also the Keeper's trousers.

tokens.name: hull
tokens.usage: Wooden boat hulls, dock planks.

tokens.name: hull-dark
tokens.usage: Hull shadow line, dock posts, boots.

tokens.name: sail
tokens.usage: Sails, gulls, the captain cap crown.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Stars in clear sky (Calm Waters and Dawn show more of them).

tokens.name: frost
tokens.usage: Frost pixels on the lamp glass when the headset signal is poor. Never used for failure.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: 1-pixel sprite outlines and pixel-panel borders on light grounds.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Background of menus, the Dawn summary and the parent settings screen.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Pixel panels, dialogue bubbles, cards on `surface`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Notched pixel-panel borders and dividers (decorative, not text).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill (Start the night, Next tide).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Boat arrived home, passengers-rescued tallies. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: route
tokens.usage: The Pilot's drawn route (dashed) and the Pilot's highlight. Chosen to stand apart from `beam` and `sea`.

tokens.name: skin-1
tokens.usage: Keeper avatar skin option 1 (same in every palette).

tokens.name: skin-2
tokens.usage: Keeper avatar skin option 2.

tokens.name: skin-3
tokens.usage: Keeper avatar skin option 3.

tokens.name: skin-4
tokens.usage: Keeper avatar skin option 4.

styles.name: game-title
styles.usage: Title screen and the Dawn banner only.

styles.name: game-heading
styles.usage: Phase banners: Lamp Lighting, Calm Waters, Tide n, Storm Ship, Dawn.

styles.name: game-small
styles.usage: Counters and captions in game. Never smaller than 16px — the youngest players are 7.

styles.name: parent-heading
styles.usage: Headings on the parent settings screen.

styles.name: parent-body
styles.sample: Changes apply at the next rest.
styles.usage: Body copy, control labels and encouraging-phrase cards.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: One art pixel at 4× scale. Pixel-panel borders and notches.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons and between icon and label.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; screen-edge gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels and sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large separation on title and Dawn screens.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything in the game itself — pixel art has square corners (panels get notched corners instead).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and chips on the parent settings screen.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards on the parent settings screen.

art.note: Pixel canvas settings for the game scene.

tokens.name: art-width
tokens.usage: Native scene width in art pixels (16:9).

tokens.name: art-height
tokens.usage: Native scene height in art pixels. 1920×1080 = exactly 8× scale; 960×540 = 4×.

tokens.name: art-scale
tokens.usage: Default integer upscale. Always scale by whole numbers with smoothing off.
